text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Ugh... My head feels all fuzzy... Doing 
training in this state is...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Maybe over there... I can sort out my 
thoughts for a bit..........

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...As I thought, this place really calms 
me down... Ah... The sky looks like a 
clock today.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
The long hand of the sun, and the short 
hand of the moon... Heheh. A sun that 
never sets... and a moon that never 
wanes...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Like reincarnation... slowly... 
turning, drifting, flowing... time...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...The time............? I feel like I'm 
forgetting something——"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Are fish flying...? ...Oh right, 
it's high tide for the sea of clouds...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...That's it, maybe now... I can swim 
too...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"It looks so fun... Me too... but... No... 
If I do that, I'll..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, I have to hurry... The sea is... 
getting away...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, she ended up slacking off on her 
training...
